Hanno Eco-Tourism Association

Forests nurture trees, and skilled craftspeople use traditional methods to build homes that showcase the beauty of wood to the fullest.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000 | Elementary school and younger ¥1,000 (includes guide, lunch, and insurance)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guides】Takayuki Okabe and Seiichi Oyama (Okabe Lumber)

【What to bring】Water bottle, towel, work gloves

summary: 木の家探訪〜森から家へ〜第2回「製材と木材」
